title: Homology of the affine Koszul Hom model
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open, $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $n\in\mathbf N$, $f:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to A$ and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Let $T$ be associated sheafification followed by transport from $\operatorname{Spec}A$ to $U$ and let $E=T(K_A(f))$ with chain degree $k$ placed in cochain degree $-k$ [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex]. There is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $H^q(\mathcal Hom_U^\bullet(E,\mathcal O_U[0]))\simeq T(H^q(K_A(f)^\vee))$, where the Hom and signed dual complexes are [def-pur-hom-complex, def-sc-koszul-dual-complex]. This is independent of regularity or an augmentation.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ local finite free Hom computation; Schemes Tag 01HV, associated sheaf exactness

proof.text: Take the complex isomorphism affine_koszul_hom_complex_iso and apply the ordinary homology functor in degree q.

Apply the shared theorem tilde_preserves_finite_limits. Tilde is a left adjoint and preserves finite colimits. Chart restriction preserves finite limits and colimits, so their composite is exact. The chart restriction instance is supplied by the quasi-coherent kernel module.
Compose homology of the complex isomorphism with Functor.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso at the actual signed dual complex. This gives exactly the associated module homology in the assertion.

theorem affine_koszul_hom_coordinates
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens) (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)) (q : ℤ) :
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    let E := (T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) n f).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
    Nonempty ((homComplex (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf) E
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit U.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf))).homology q ≅
      T.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualCochainComplex
        (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) n f).homology q))
